architecture: moving asset -> static route waypoint -> v_nom -> CBF-QP -> v_safe -> velocity executor

benchmark_simplification.note: canonical, unchanged; no new clutter generator

cbf_qp.substep_recomputation: re-solved every dt_sub=0.1s substep when >=1 hazard is active at a step's start (NOT held constant across the full 0.5s external step, unlike Prompt 1's identity path) -- required so the stopping-margin formula's own dt_sub reaction-time assumption is actually realized; see README.md

environment.defender: structurally present, cannot terminate the episode (intercept_radius=1e-6, reused unchanged from Prompt 1)

freeze_rule: clearance, alpha, active_range, kp, physical limits, polygon sides, replan period/triggers are frozen BEFORE the acceptance run and never tuned afterward
hypothesis: A route planner (reused, unmodified visibility-graph + A*) for global deadlock avoidance, combined with a per-instant CBF-QP safety filter over inflated static-obstacle AABBs, lets A1-CBF navigate canonical C2 static clutter while pursuing the moving asset, without any RL.

route_planner.role: global/local-minimum deadlock avoidance ONLY -- never safety margins

scope: static-obstacle navigation ONLY; no defender CBF, no dynamic-obstacle CBF, no RL training
